description: This file defines the 'AOS_Products' class which extends 'AOS_Products_sugar'. It customizes product handling within SuiteCRM, including GUID generation, file uploads, and a custom query for purchased products. The class provides methods for generating GUIDs, handling image uploads with validation, and retrieving related purchase data.

classes.name: AOS_Products
classes.description: Custom extension of AOS_Products_sugar with additional methods for GUID generation, image upload handling, and purchase query.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: getGUID
methods.description: Generates a unique GUID string, either using 'com_create_guid' if available or a manual method.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the parent save method to handle attachment deletion, image upload with validation, and performs additional save processing.

methods.name: getCustomersPurchasedProductsQuery
methods.description: Returns a SQL query string for retrieving products that customers have purchased and associated quotes.
